steps.content: [In the Shadows]

The twisting pain inside Shuang'er offers no sign of easing. Her medicine bottles have long sat empty. Even if medicinal herbs still exist somewhere in the manor, those intruders will surely ransack and destroy them sooner or later.
Now, she must rely on herself alone to suppress the agonizing backlash pain wracking her body.
Deep within her mind, her five senses begin to sharpen. Her breath deepens, becoming slow and measured, as perceptions far beyond those of ordinary people awaken within her—

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Cheepy and Chirpy... are they looking for me? I'm fine. Just don't let anyone know you're connected to me. That's all I ask.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Fighting to the east... a staff hitting the ground. It's Yin Yansheng. And another one... a tiger's roar, loud and showy. Xiaofeng... She said she was just here to watch the show, didn't she? Look how that turned out.

Sweat beads on her forehead and vaporizes into white mist, seared by the heat of her churning internal energy. At the critical moment of her meditation, the air currents around her warp and shimmer with invisible force.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: The other side sounds like a mess... not like they're searching for anyone, though. The codex's right here with me. What are they tearing up my room for?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: And footsteps... light ones. Careful. Someone's trying really hard not to be heard... they're close, right...
She opens her eyes to the sound of footsteps crunching through snow just outside the stone crevice, perilously close.
Her breath regulation is only halfway complete. To forcibly end the meditation now would render all her efforts futile. She does not react, forcing her voice to remain steady and calm.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: I would advise against approaching further. This place is layered with defensive traps. One misstep and you may find yourself unable to retreat.
The footsteps halt about ten feet away, hanging back rather than pressing forward.
A cautious type? But it isn't Ji Guining. Wheelchair wheels make a very distinct sound.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: You seek the codex, I presume. Then you have witnessed the chaos engulfing this manor. This text draws only endless covetous eyes and brings naught but calamity to whoever possesses it.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: If you take it from me and others discover this fact... the fates of Jiewubei and Xu Shen shall become your own. The entire Northwild martial world will not rest until you are destroyed.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: And if you must skulk in shadows, never daring to reveal what you carry... then pray tell, what meaning remains in standing at the pinnacle of the martial world?
The figure actually heeds her words, staying perfectly still. Her voice softens.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Since you appear to be someone who heeds reason, I propose an accord: you and I join forces to sweep away these intruders first. My cultivation has been perfected, and this codex... can be yours.
There is still no response. The silence only deepens her unease, and she tightens her grip on the long staff beside her.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: If you have terms to propose, speak them plainly. I have little patience for—

Her sentence trails off as the sound of footsteps fills the corridor, heading straight for the hidden chamber. The stone door swings open, and she reacts on instinct, breaking her meditation mid-breath, channeling power into a decisive strike—
The blow freezes an inch from your face. Through the doorway, you stand before her, travel-worn and glistening with unmelted snow.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You didn't even let me answer. I was about to say I came seeking the same thing. Cooperation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Manor Master Jichuan.
You study the pale face before you, and the crude wooden staff that still hangs in the air, refusing to fall.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Lonely peak casts its shadow, startling the dragon in the cold water... You used that very move to rescue me from the poison fog trap.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where are these inescapable traps you mentioned? And this "perfected cultivation" you claim... does it always leave you so pale, Manor Master? The blood on the ground... is that also part of your cultivation?
She stands paralyzed, her gaze averted from yours. The weapon lowers in her grip.
From a distance, the roar of angry voices and the whistle of hurtling weapons grow rapidly nearer. You wait, but no answer comes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Manor Master, if you keep staying silent, how are we supposed to work together?
A flicker of shock crosses her face. She hadn't expected you to still cooperate. She opens her mouth to speak, but the words never come.
Instead, she doubles over, coughing a hot, thick stream of dark blood onto the bluestone floor. The sound of it hitting the stone is sickening.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: My... my internal energy is unstable. I need time to recover.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: How long?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: One incense stick's time. You can't hold them off.
You steady her with a hand on her arm. Through your palm, you feel her distinct trembling and coldness. Any further questions die in your throat.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If I can hold them off, would I have a chance to hear the manor master explain everything that's happened here?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Forget it... I'm saving you because you remind me of a friend. I've only known her for a few days, and she can be quite a handful, but thanks to her help, I gained some insight into the martial world.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Her name is Shuang'er.
The sounds of battle creep closer to the cave. You pull out the silver bells Xiaofeng left you; their chime echoes through the mountain ravine, stirring the slumbering white tiger awake.

Inside the manor, Xiaofeng remains in the meeting hall, amusing herself by sparring with the Immortal Healer. But the tiger's roar erupts with such dominance that it shakes the entire estate, an impossible sound for anyone to ignore. The distant clash of weapons falters and falls silent, then the clamor shifts, surging toward the roar.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If someone like me could stumble onto this place, it was only a matter of time before they found it too. Meowy can keep them busy for a bit. We'll double back the other way.
